# t7.3.1 — Corrected Menu-Hidden Observation False-Positive

## Summary

Fixed the dashboard menu-hidden observation so an unrelated empty locator can no longer be treated as evidence that the menu is hidden. The known menu labels are sourced from the existing DashboardMenu feature. A hidden result is returned only when all twelve expected links exist in the DOM and each is invisible. The existing assertion path now uses the same fail-closed observation as the optional POM capability.

## Changes

- `src/pages/dashBoardPage.ts` — replaced the nonexistent literal `menuOption` selector with the known dashboard menu set; inspect each label with `includeHidden: true`; require a complete match set and no visible menu items; delegate `verifyMenuHidden()` to this observation.
- `src/agentic/tests/pom-page-object.test.ts` — extended the existing scenario-to-POM regression test to prove the capability reports `false` when Admin is visible, even though the old literal selector had no match. Added coverage for fully hidden, visible, absent, and partial menu states, including the hidden-link query option.

The existing registration in `src/agentic/tests/foundation.test.ts` was already present in the worktree and was not changed in this task.
